[[File:ProwCarving-ProwBeaten.png|thumb|right|upright|An Ewok prow carving on a Dulok ship]]
A '''prow carving''' was a type of artwork created by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]] that inhabited [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The carving was an important part of the Ewoks' [[Fishing Festival]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] accidentally lost the prow carving in a [[Unidentified Endor river|river]]. The [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|rival tribe]] found it and mounted it on their [[Dulok battleship|battleship]] to give them luck as they attempted to pillage the Ewok celebration and plunder all their [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. Warrick and three friends&mdash;[[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]&mdash;recovered the prow carving from the Duloks only to lose it again. However, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], leader of their tribe, revealed that another had been made to replace it.
